## Table 5 - Cost of 10,000 conversations x 30 turns

Pricing: input $1 per million tokens, output $5 per million tokens. Tokens include the reply call and the background calls (episode extraction and summaries).

| Setting | Input tokens | Output tokens | Input cost | Output cost | Total cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SHORT_TERM_N=4 | 214,760,000 | 27,340,000 | $214.76 | $136.70 | $351.46 |
| SHORT_TERM_N=12 | 291,060,000 | 29,210,000 | $291.06 | $146.05 | $437.11 |
| SHORT_TERM_N=30 | 419,390,000 | 30,250,000 | $419.39 | $151.25 | $570.64 |
| Compression policy (N=30, last 6 verbatim) | 287,950,000 | 30,470,000 | $287.95 | $152.35 | $440.30 |

Best setting: **SHORT_TERM_N=12**. Worst setting: **SHORT_TERM_N=4**.

How they were chosen: best = highest mean probe score, and if several settings are within 0.2 points of the top, the cheapest of them. Worst = lowest mean probe score, and if several are within the same margin, the most expensive of them. The rule was fixed before the runs and is in make_hw06_metrics.py.
